transitions._comment: CAD-41 — this was `"role": "any"`. Releasing a design is the gate into manufacturing: entering `approved` runs designreview/on_design_file_approved, and the DesignVersion → DesignBOM → Item/Routing/BOM chain refuses to run until the parent file is approved. So `any` meant a read-only viewer — typically the external or vendor persona — could release a design for manufacture and start the product. `design_admin` is the role that holds `delete` on DesignFile; releasing is at least that consequential. `design_user` may still reopen, so an engineer is not locked out of their own work.
Reopening un-releases a file; it does not start manufacture, so it stays with the engineers rather than with `any`.

branch_rule.description: checklists-OP1. Copied verbatim from the template item when the run is minted, and then IMMUTABLE: it is not in engine/checklists/branching.ANSWER_FIELDS, so engine/doc_entry_lock.validate_checklist_answers refuses to change it on a started run. That is deliberate - a run must execute the logic that was in force when it started, not whatever the template says today, or an inspection's evidence would change meaning after the fact.

branch_skipped.description: checklists-OP1. DERIVED, NOT AUTHORED: `engine/checklists/branching.derive_branch_state(items)` is the only thing that decides it, and engine/doc_entry_lock.validate_checklist_answers recomputes it on every in-progress save and REFUSES a payload that disagrees. True means the authored condition for this item did not hold, so it is not applicable to this run - it is NOT an answer, and no response, completion, note or photo is ever written on the strength of a branch (LT-19 stored the literal string 'Skipped placeholder' as a real answer; this stores nothing). It is false on every item of every run that existed before this field, so `required_items_pending` counts them exactly as it did.

branch_rule.description: checklists-OP1. The authored condition under which this item APPLIES, as a compact JSON object: {"when_order": <an EARLIER item's order>, "op": <equals|not_equals|contains|gt|lt|gte|lte|is_checked|is_not_checked>, "value": <text>, "risk_label": <why this branch exists>}. Empty means the item always applies, which is every item on every template that existed before this field. A branch NEVER adds, removes, reorders or rewrites an item and NEVER writes an answer - it only decides applicability, because engine/doc_entry_lock.validate_checklist_answers refuses any change to a started run's item definitions and a design that deleted items to hide them could not be executed at all. `risk_label` is a LABEL: nothing computes a risk score from it. The ONE evaluator is engine/checklists/branching.py; schemas/_scripts/checklists/branch_rules.py is the only writer of this field and refuses a rule the runner could not execute (LT-19).

nominal.description: C-059 — the nominal a measurement item is judged against, when the template defines one. FAI runs get theirs from the drawing balloon instead.

tol_minus.description: C-059 — lower tolerance magnitude on nominal; blank is read as zero.

tol_plus.description: C-059 — upper tolerance on nominal; blank is read as zero.

unit.description: C-059 — the unit nominal and tolerances are in.

transitions.description: Submit the stock entry: posts the stock ledger and the GL for the movement and locks the entry from edits.
Discard a draft stock entry; nothing has posted, so nothing is reversed.
Cancel a submitted stock entry (admin only): reverses the posted stock ledger and GL with a dated counter-voucher.

line_key.description: Per-line identity from the device, so a resync of a partially delivered sheet converges line by line instead of appending duplicates.
